name: AlertBanner
description: Inline alert for info, warning, success, and error feedback.

tone.description: Semantic tone controlling icon and surface colors.

action.description: Optional action slot rendered under the description (e.g. a tertiary Button).

showIcon.description: Show the semantic tone icon. The icon is derived from `tone`; set false for a text-only banner.

dismissible.description: Shows a localized dismiss control when true.

onDismiss.description: Called when the user dismisses the banner.

aria-live.description: Live region politeness for assistive tech (an explicit value wins over the tone default).

focusOnMount.description:
Moves focus to the banner when it mounts, for form error summaries: keyboard
and screen reader users land on the list of problems after a failed submit.
